content.value_statement: VitePress projects require accurate configuration, routing, theme, and deployment guidance. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code focused VitePress reference support.
actual_capabilities: Explains VitePress config, CLI commands, base paths, markdown options, and file-based routing.
Guides Vue component usage inside Markdown, including imports, global components, runtime data, and style preprocessors.
Describes data loaders and dynamic route generation from local files or remote APIs.
Covers default theme configuration for nav, sidebars, search, social links, footer, and edit links.
Provides deployment notes for GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, Firebase, Nginx, and other hosts.
limitations: It is a reference skill, not a live VitePress package or project generator.
Examples may need adjustment for each repository layout and hosting provider.
It does not validate credentials, deploy sites, or run builds by itself.
It is based on VitePress 1.x documentation generated on January 28, 2026.

use_cases.title: Add Vue Interactivity To Markdown
use_cases.description: Use Vue components, runtime data, client-only behavior, and style preprocessors inside Markdown pages.

use_cases.title: Prepare Static Hosting Deployment
use_cases.description: Map VitePress build commands, base paths, output directories, and platform settings for static hosting.

prompt_templates.title: Plan A New VitePress Site
prompt_templates.prompt: I am starting a VitePress documentation site. Review the expected folder structure, config purpose, routing rules, and first pages to create.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Navigation And Sidebar
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my VitePress information architecture. Suggest navigation, sidebar, search, footer, and edit-link settings for a clear documentation experience.

prompt_templates.title: Design Data-Driven Pages
prompt_templates.prompt: I need VitePress pages generated from local files or an API. Explain the data loader and dynamic route approach I should use.

prompt_templates.title: Audit SSR And Deployment Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this VitePress plan for SSR-sensitive components, browser-only imports, base path issues, output paths, and hosting platform settings.

output_examples.input: Help me plan a docs site for a Vue library.
output: A recommended documentation structure with guide, API, examples, and release notes sections.
Navigation and sidebar suggestions that match VitePress default theme behavior.
A launch checklist for config, search, base path, and deployment settings.

output_examples.input: Explain how to add interactive examples to Markdown pages.
output: Guidance on local and global Vue components in Markdown.
SSR safety notes for browser-only packages and client-only rendering.
Styling recommendations for scoped, module, and preprocessor-based styles.

output_examples.input: Prepare my VitePress site for static hosting.
output: Platform-specific build and publish settings to verify.
Base path and output directory checks for sub-path deployments.
Warnings about HTML minification, asset caching, and preview validation.

best_practices: Review .vitepress/config.ts before changing navigation, search, base path, or output directories.
Keep build-time data loaders limited to trusted local files and trusted APIs.
Test SSR-sensitive components with ClientOnly or client-only imports before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode private credentials in theme or search configuration.
Do not copy deployment paths without confirming the repository structure.
Do not import browser-only packages during SSR without a client guard.

faq.question: What can this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps with VitePress configuration, routing, Markdown features, theme setup, data loading, SSR compatibility, and deployment planning.

faq.question: Does it create a full site automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples that Claude, Codex, or Claude Code can apply in your project.

faq.question: Which VitePress version is covered?
faq.answer: The reference material targets VitePress 1.x and was generated on January 28, 2026.

faq.question: Can it help with Vue components in Markdown?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers local imports, global components, runtime data, client-only components, and related styling options.

faq.question: Can it help with deployment settings?
faq.answer: Yes. It summarizes build commands, base paths, output directories, and common host settings for static deployments.

faq.question: Does it handle secrets or credentials?
faq.answer: No. Keep private credentials out of VitePress config and use provider-specific secret management where needed.
